description.blurb: S/2006 S 11 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2004 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2006 S 11 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 19.7 million km in 1042.28 days. It has an inclination of 174.1° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.144.
